name: Dyn-Bench
description: Dyn-Bench is a dynamic, human-in-the-loop adversarial benchmarking suite that collects evolving, crowdsourced adversarial examples to stress-test NLP models. It measures robustness and generalization across tasks by continuously incorporating human-generated failure cases and new challenge types.
evaluation_method: Human_eval for adversarial robustness plus task-specific metrics such as accuracy/F1 on held-out evaluations
reputation: Well-known community-driven platform for adversarial benchmarking and robustness evaluation, with broad adoption among robustness researchers.
